items.statement: Let E be a finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, including rank zero. Let V:E→ℝ be C², let α,β≥0 satisfy 0<α≤β and α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v, and let η>0 with βη≤1. Fix arbitrary y,xRef∈E, z₀=(x₀,p₀)∈E×E and an arbitrary sequence e_n≥0. Define c=y−η∇V(xRef); Φ_t(x,p)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p); S(x,p)=(x,p−(2⟨p,∇V(x)−∇V(xRef)⟩/‖∇V(x)−∇V(xRef)‖²)(∇V(x)−∇V(xRef))), using total real division, so a zero normal gives the identity; λ(x,p)=√η max(0,⟨p,∇V(x)−∇V(xRef)⟩); H(x,p)=(η⁻¹‖x−c‖²+‖p‖²)/2; C(z)=√η β√(2H(z))(√(2ηH(z))+‖c−xRef‖); Λ_z(t)=∫₀ᵗλ(Φ_s z)ds for t≥0; and τ_z(e)=inf{t≥0:Λ_z(t)≥e}∈[0,∞], with inf∅=∞. Records are the disjoint union of finite active pairs (T,z) and a phase-free stopped symbol †. Define next_e(†)=†; for an active (T,z), put next_e(T,z)=† if τ_z(e)=∞, otherwise next_e(T,z)=(T+τ_z(e),S(Φ_(τ_z(e))z)). Define r₀=(0,z₀), r_(n+1)=next_(e_n)(r_n), and T_n as the finite time coordinate when r_n is active and ∞ when it is stopped. Then: (1) the initial record is exactly (0,z₀); (2) the successor identity holds, and an active record stops at the next index iff its actual clock is infinite, otherwise it has exactly the displayed active successor; (3) next is jointly Borel in y,xRef,e,r; (4) for each n, r_n is jointly Borel in y,xRef,z₀ and the whole threshold sequence; (5) T_n is jointly Borel in the same inputs; (6) T₀=0 and T_n is nondecreasing; (7) a stopped record at n remains stopped at every n+k; (8) if r_n=(T,z), then H(z)=H(z₀), and for every t≥0 with t<τ_z(e_n), H(Φ_tz)=H(z₀) and 0≤λ(Φ_tz)≤C(z₀); (9) C₀=C(z₀)≥0, C₀>0 implies T_n+max(e_n/C₀,0)≤T_(n+1) for every n, including stopped records, while C₀=0 and an active record with e_n>0 imply that the next record is stopped; (10) for an active r_n=(T,z), e_n=0 gives r_(n+1)=(T,S(z)), while e_n>0 and a finite active successor (T′,z′) imply T<T′. All statements concern the actual finite indexed recursion with fixed y,xRef. No iid realization, almost-sure nonaccumulation, single physical-time phase in the presence of zero thresholds, all-time process, Markov law, invariance, terminal sampler or cost theorem is asserted.
assumptions: E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its compatible norm and Borel measurable structure; rank zero is allowed. Products and the threshold sequence space carry product measurable structures; the record space carries the native disjoint-union structure.
V:E→ℝ is C² on all E. Nonnegative α,β satisfy 0<α≤β, and α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for all x,v∈E.

η>0 and βη≤1. These and the preceding potential conditions are the six original analytic callers. The actual flow, bounce, clock, measurable record maps, conserved energy, cap and increment are produced within the proof, never supplied as callers.
y,xRef∈E and initial phase z₀∈E×E are arbitrary. The threshold sequence e:ℕ→[0,∞) is arbitrary, including zeros. It is not assumed to have any probability law; e_n corresponds to source E_(n+1).

An active record is (T,z) with finite T≥0 and phase z. A stopped record has no phase and extended event time ∞. The literal next map tests whether the actual first clock is ∞ before evaluating its finite waiting value, flow or bounce.

The cap C₀ is the displayed actual formula evaluated at the original z₀. The positive-cap and zero-cap branches have their own implication guards. Strict time growth requires a positive threshold and a finite active successor. Arbitrary zero thresholds may repeat an event time with different postjump phases.

formulae.label: Actual harmonic flow
formulae.tex: c=y-\eta\nabla V(x_{\rm ref}),\quad\Phi_t(x,p)=\bigl(c+\cos t(x-c)+\sqrt\eta\sin t\,p,-\tfrac{\sin t}{\sqrt\eta}(x-c)+\cos t\,p\bigr).

formulae.label: Actual zero-safe reflection and rate
formulae.tex: h(x)=\nabla V(x)-\nabla V(x_{\rm ref}),\quad S(x,p)=\bigl(x,p-\tfrac{2\langle p,h(x)\rangle}{\|h(x)\|^2}h(x)\bigr),\quad\lambda(x,p)=\sqrt\eta\max\{0,\langle p,h(x)\rangle\}.

callers.statement: V ∈ C² on the whole finite-dimensional real inner-product space

callers.header_literal:
(hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2)
callers.statement: For every x and v, α * ‖v‖² ≤ inner (Hess V x v) v and inner (Hess V x v) v ≤ β * ‖v‖²

conclusion_groups.literal:
(∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ e : ℕ → ℝ≥0,
      record y xRef z₀ e 0 = Sum.inl (0, z₀)) ∧
conclusion_groups.title: Base

conclusion_groups.literal:
(∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ e : ℕ → ℝ≥0, ∀ n : ℕ,
      record y xRef z₀ e (n + 1) = next y xRef (e n) (record y xRef z₀ e n) ∧
      (∀ a : ℝ≥0 × (E × E), record y xRef z₀ e n = Sum.inl a →
        (record y xRef z₀ e (n + 1) = Sum.inr () ↔ τ y xRef a.2 (e n) = ⊤) ∧
        (τ y xRef a.2 (e n) ≠ ⊤ → record y xRef z₀ e (n + 1) =
          Sum.inl (a.1 + (τ y xRef a.2 (e n)).untopD 0,
            S xRef (Φ y xRef (((τ y xRef a.2 (e n)).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2))))) ∧
conclusion_groups.title: Recursion and finite/top update

conclusion_groups.literal:
Measurable (fun a : (E × E) × ℝ≥0 × ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) =>
      next a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 a.2.2) ∧
conclusion_groups.title: Joint Borel next

conclusion_groups.literal:
(∀ n : ℕ, Measurable (fun a : (E × E) × (E × E) × (ℕ → ℝ≥0) =>
      record a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 a.2.2 n)) ∧
conclusion_groups.title: Joint Borel finite record

conclusion_groups.literal:
(∀ n : ℕ, Measurable (fun a : (E × E) × (E × E) × (ℕ → ℝ≥0) =>
      eventTime a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 a.2.2 n)) ∧
conclusion_groups.title: Joint Borel event time

conclusion_groups.literal:
(∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ e : ℕ → ℝ≥0,
      eventTime y xRef z₀ e 0 = 0 ∧ Monotone (eventTime y xRef z₀ e)) ∧
conclusion_groups.title: Initial and monotone event times

conclusion_groups.literal:
(∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ e : ℕ → ℝ≥0, ∀ n k : ℕ,
      record y xRef z₀ e n = Sum.inr () →
        record y xRef z₀ e (n + k) = Sum.inr ()) ∧
conclusion_groups.title: Absorbing stop

conclusion_groups.literal:
(∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ e : ℕ → ℝ≥0, ∀ n : ℕ,
      ∀ a : ℝ≥0 × (E × E), record y xRef z₀ e n = Sum.inl a →
        H y xRef a.2 = H y xRef z₀ ∧
        ∀ t : ℝ≥0, (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) < τ y xRef a.2 (e n) →
          H y xRef (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) a.2) = H y xRef z₀ ∧
          0 ≤ rate xRef (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) a.2) ∧
          rate xRef (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) a.2) ≤ C y xRef z₀) ∧
conclusion_groups.title: Same original energy and outgoing arc cap

conclusion_groups.literal:
(∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ e : ℕ → ℝ≥0,
      0 ≤ C y xRef z₀ ∧
      (0 < C y xRef z₀ → ∀ n : ℕ,
        eventTime y xRef z₀ e n +
          (Real.toNNReal ((e n : ℝ) / C y xRef z₀) : WithTop ℝ≥0) ≤
        eventTime y xRef z₀ e (n + 1)) ∧
      (C y xRef z₀ = 0 → ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ a : ℝ≥0 × (E × E),
        record y xRef z₀ e n = Sum.inl a → 0 < e n →
          record y xRef z₀ e (n + 1) = Sum.inr ())) ∧
conclusion_groups.title: Uniform extended time increment and zero cap

conclusion_groups.literal:
(∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ e : ℕ → ℝ≥0, ∀ n : ℕ,
      ∀ a : ℝ≥0 × (E × E), record y xRef z₀ e n = Sum.inl a →
        (e n = 0 → record y xRef z₀ e (n + 1) = Sum.inl (a.1, S xRef a.2)) ∧
        (∀ b : ℝ≥0 × (E × E), 0 < e n →
          record y xRef z₀ e (n + 1) = Sum.inl b → a.1 < b.1))
conclusion_groups.title: Zero threshold and conditional strict growth

data_quantifiers.arc_variable: t:NNReal or finite real t with t≥0; outgoing arc interpretation restricted to 0≤t<τ
data_quantifiers.fixed_analytic_data: E,V,α,β,η with original six callers and five typing classes

literal_definitions.literal: let c : E → E → E := fun y xRef => y - η • gradient V xRef
literal_definitions.name: c

literal_definitions.literal:
let Φ : E → E → ℝ → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun y xRef t z =>
      (c y xRef + Real.cos t • (z.1 - c y xRef) +
          (Real.sqrt η * Real.sin t) • z.2,
       (-Real.sin t / Real.sqrt η) • (z.1 - c y xRef) + Real.cos t • z.2)
literal_definitions.name: Φ

literal_definitions.literal:
let S : E → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun xRef z =>
      (z.1, z.2 - (2 * inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef) /
        ‖gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef‖ ^ 2) • (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
literal_definitions.name: S

literal_definitions.literal:
let rate : E → (E × E) → ℝ := fun xRef z =>
      Real.sqrt η * max 0 (inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
literal_definitions.name: rate

literal_definitions.literal:
let H : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ := fun y xRef z =>
      (η⁻¹ * ‖z.1 - c y xRef‖ ^ 2 + ‖z.2‖ ^ 2) / 2
literal_definitions.name: H

literal_definitions.literal:
let C : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ := fun y xRef z =>
      Real.sqrt η * (β : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (2 * H y xRef z) *
        (Real.sqrt (2 * η * H y xRef z) + ‖c y xRef - xRef‖)
literal_definitions.name: C

literal_definitions.literal:
let Λ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → ℝ := fun y xRef z t =>
      ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), rate xRef (Φ y xRef s z)
literal_definitions.name: Λ

literal_definitions.literal:
let τ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → WithTop ℝ≥0 := fun y xRef z e =>
      MeasureTheory.hittingAfter
        (fun t : ℝ≥0 => fun a : (E × E) × (E × E) × ℝ≥0 =>
          Λ a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 t - (a.2.2 : ℝ))
        (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) 0 ((y, xRef), z, e)
literal_definitions.name: τ

literal_definitions.literal:
let next : E → E → ℝ≥0 → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) →
        ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef e r =>
      match r with
      | Sum.inr _ => Sum.inr ()
      | Sum.inl a =>
        if τ y xRef a.2 e = ⊤ then Sum.inr () else
          Sum.inl (a.1 + (τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0,
            S xRef (Φ y xRef (((τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2))
literal_definitions.name: next

literal_definitions.literal:
let record : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ≥0) → ℕ →
        ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef z₀ e n =>
      Nat.rec (Sum.inl (0, z₀)) (fun k r => next y xRef (e k) r) n
literal_definitions.name: record
